messages:
nora: quick follow-up from the streaming rfc  thinking about a gateway-level envelope adapter that can present v5 streaming as v4-compatible chunk frames for older clients. avoids forcing immediate SDK updates. thoughts?
lee: I like the low-friction aspect. main concerns: buffering introduces latency and memory hotspots for long responses.
sam: Agree on memory risk. We could stream through until we hit a small envelope boundary then flush partial frames, but that complicates correctness guarantees.
anya: If we do partial flushes, how do we preserve event semantics? v5 has typed events (meta, deltas, done). v4 clients expect text blobs in choices[]. Might need a deterministic mapping.
ora: Proposal sketch: adapter translates v5 events -> v4 deltas, emits incremental choices[]. Keep a small per-request ring buffer (e.g., 8KB) for coalescing tokens, flush on punctuation or 200ms timer. If buffer grows > 64KB, failover path to passthrough with x-rw-adapted:fail header.
ora: Add: metric "shim.coalesce_latency_ms" and counters for "shim.fallback_passthrough" and "shim.memory_spike".
infra-bot: canary deploy queued: staging/stream-envelope-adapter v0.0.1  rolling 2 nodes (ETA 3m)
ops: Important: backpressure. If downstream v3 clients are slow to accept frames we must surface backpressure to the runtime or break the stream to avoid head-of-line blocking. Need kill-switch per-route.
lee: Implementation detail: adapter should be horizontally scalable and stateless if possible. Use per-request ephemeral state in the proxy process, not external cache. Sticky routing could help but avoid by design.
sam: Test plan: golden prompts with deterministic seeds, assert token sequence equivalence when not using coalesce timer. Add chaos tests that inject delayed downstream reads.
anya: UX note: Console should show when a tenant is on "stream-adapter" with a per-tenant latency delta. Product wants to warn customers about potential subtle differences.
nora: Rollout plan: internal tenants 5 days, canary 5% prod 48h, increase if shim.fallback_passthrough < 0.5% and p95 latency delta < 30ms. Fall back if memory_spike > 0.1% of requests.
ops: Rollback hooks: tenant kill-switch + global feature flag + autoscale policy to spin extra adapter replicas. Also add a short-lived header x-rw-adapted to responses so SDKs can surface debug warnings.
product: We'll update client docs and add a blurb in Console about "adapter mode". Keep phrasing clear: "minimal translation, edge-case differences possible".
nora: Next actions: Sam protos adapter, Lee writes perf tests + harness, Anya coordinates Console flags, Ops to prepare kill-switch. Sync Thurs standup. Thanks all :sparkles:
